fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) has recorded five consecutive trading days of decline, with Zacks Research downgrading from 'Strong Buy' to 'Hold' and setting a target price of $1,881.
fields.summary_ko.1: There is 150% upside from the current stock price of approximately $762 to the target price; however, investor concerns have expanded due to the Nvidia CEO scandal and downward revisions in AI chip capital expenditure forecasts for 2027-2029 (19-41% decline).
